decision.reasoning_trace: I narrowed my search to a mix of high-end home audio and durable portable options. The Sony SRS-RA3000 and B&O Beosound A1 were strong contenders for their superior sound quality, but their higher price points were a significant factor. The EWA and EDUPLINK offered great budget value, but I was looking for something with a bit more output power. I ultimately selected the Raymate Bluetooth Speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) because it provides a 30W output and IPX7 waterproofing at a very accessible mid-range price. The reviews highlighted its 'powerhouse' sound relative to its size, making it the most balanced choice for both indoor and outdoor use.
